solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Disconcerting to be away at golf practice?

parts.note: to be away is to be off, as in 'off on holiday'
putting is practising short strokes on a golf green; the question mark flags the playful reading

explanation.surface: A golfer finds it unsettling to be called away while practising on the green.
explanation.definitionFit: Something disconcerting unsettles you and puts you off, the sense of the hyphenated adjective.

clue.text: Likely to find pips here?

definitions.meaning: pips are the suit symbols printed on playing cards, so that is where one finds them

explanation.surface: Someone wonders where pips are probably to be found.
explanation.definitionFit: A probable event is said idiomatically to be foreseen in the playing cards a fortune-teller reads.

clue.text: Consider reduced payment

indicators.note: reduced means the word is cut short, losing its final letter

parts.note: to consider is to feel, as in 'I feel that...'

explanation.surface: Someone is asked to weigh up a cut-price charge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'reduced' trims the last letter, L, from FEEL.
explanation.definitionFit: A charge paid for a professional service is a payment.

clue.text: Out of bed, drunk and irritable

parts.note: someone out of bed is up
tight is informal for drunk

explanation.surface: A grumpy reveller is up, still tipsy and short-tempered.
explanation.definitionFit: Tense, anxious and easily annoyed: an informal synonym for irritable.

clue.text: Counted aloud as bell did this?

indicators.note: aloud says the word for counted is to be heard, giving a word spelt differently

parts.note: told means counted, as in 'all told' or a teller counting votes

explanation.surface: Someone counted out loud the way a bell strikes the hours.
explanation.definitionFit: A bell that rang with slow repeated strokes is said to have rung out in that way, a verb used for bells.

clue.text: It may be black chess piece (not king)

indicators.note: not says the following letter is to be left out of the piece

parts.note: the knight is the chess piece that moves in an L shape
K is the chess notation for king

explanation.surface: A chess player notes that a piece other than the king might be black.
explanation.walkthrough: 'black' looks like it belongs with the chess piece but goes with the definition: the dark hours can be pitch black.
explanation.definitionFit: The hours of darkness are often described as black, so this is an example of a black thing.

clue.text: Off work, and why? Abroad, unhappily

definitions.meaning: split into two words: off work at home, the reason being illness
someone living abroad and pining for their own country

explanation.surface: Someone asks why a colleague is off work, and hears they are miserably overseas.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling homesick is longing for one's native place while away, so the unhappy expatriate fits; the two-word reading gives absence through illness.

clue.text: Pay for handle

definitions.meaning: to stand someone something, paying on their behalf
to deal with or behave towards someone, as in 'handle with care'

explanation.definitionFit: One verb covers both: standing someone a meal, and dealing with someone in a certain way.

clue.text: Roman soldiers, say, eaten by wild animal

indicators.note: eaten by puts the short word inside the animal, as if swallowed

parts.note: the lion is a wild big cat
say means for example, abbreviated eg

explanation.surface: Roman soldiers, for instance, are devoured by a beast, as in the arena.
explanation.definitionFit: A legion was the main unit of the Roman army, several thousand troops.

clue.text: Annexe in New York in flagrant disrepair

indicators.note: a building in disrepair has fallen apart, so the letters are broken up and rebuilt

explanation.surface: An extension in a New York building has fallen into shocking dereliction.
explanation.definitionFit: A self-contained flat added to a family house for an elderly relative is a kind of annexe.

clue.text: English bishops become less intense

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop, doubled for the plural

explanation.surface: The Church of England's senior clergy grow less fervent.
explanation.definitionFit: Like a tide going out, to diminish or decline in strength.

clue.text: Be touring a peaceful prison

indicators.note: touring means going round, so the two outer letters wrap the rest

parts.note: taken as written
still means calm and peaceful

explanation.surface: A visitor is urged to look round a tranquil old jail.
explanation.walkthrough: The Bastille was the Paris fortress-prison stormed in 1789.
explanation.definitionFit: The famous Paris fortress used as a state jail, whose storming began the French Revolution.

clue.text: Plough is heavy to carry

parts.note: great means large or heavy, as in a great weight
to bear is to carry

explanation.surface: A farmer complains the plough is too heavy to lift.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plough' looks like the farm tool, but it is the British name for the star pattern Americans call the Big Dipper.
explanation.definitionFit: The Plough is the bright pattern of seven stars within the constellation Ursa Major, so a part stands for the whole.

clue.text: Property in the form of matching items

parts.note: as means in the role or form of, as in 'dressed as a pirate'
sets are groups of matching items

explanation.surface: Property held as collections of matching pieces, like crockery.
explanation.definitionFit: Things of value owned by a person or firm are its holdings; a plural noun for property.

clue.text: A case for fighting

explanation.surface: Someone argues the merits of going to war.
explanation.definitionFit: A legal proceeding is called by this name, and so is armed combat, as in 'killed in battle'.

clue.text: Caught one departing in chopper

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
a leaver is someone who leaves

explanation.surface: Someone leaving is caught aboard a helicopter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chopper' suggests a helicopter; here it is a butcher's tool.
explanation.definitionFit: A heavy broad-bladed knife used by butchers for hacking through bone chops meat.

clue.text: Modest about myself and daughter in drama

indicators.note: about means going round, so the shy word surrounds the rest

parts.note: coy means shy or modest
me stands for myself

explanation.surface: A shy person reflects on themselves and their daughter in a play.
explanation.definitionFit: A light, humorous play is one genre of drama.

clue.text: Emphasise what one may do after work

definitions.meaning: to make a point forcefully so it sinks in

definitions.text: what one may do after work
definitions.meaning: a commuter steers the car back to the house at the end of the day

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means to press a point home, and literally to motor back to the house after the office.

clue.text: Message received from a mile off

indicators.note: off means gone wrong or out of order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A message arrives from someone a mile away.
explanation.definitionFit: An electronic message sent over the internet.

clue.text: Vital area of Turkey

indicators.note: area of means a part of the word, here its tail end, supplies the letters

explanation.surface: A crucial region of the country Turkey.
explanation.definitionFit: Crucial or essential, as in a key factor.

clue.text: Add page to rental agreement, if you would

indicators.note: add tells the solver to attach the page letter to the front of the agreement

parts.note: a lease is a contract to rent property

explanation.surface: A polite request to attach another page to the tenancy contract.
explanation.definitionFit: A polite word used in requests, meaning kindly or would you mind.

clue.text: Watch Roman poet right away

indicators.note: away says the following letter is sent off and removed

parts.note: Virgil, author of the Aeneid, is the Roman poet

explanation.surface: An order to look at the Roman poet, with something correct removed.
explanation.definitionFit: A period of staying awake to keep watch, often at night.

clue.text: Joke produces silence

definitions.meaning: to stop someone speaking, as with a cloth over the mouth

explanation.definitionFit: The same short word is a comedian's quip and a verb for muzzling someone.

clue.text: Dramatist to have fun with the Conservatives?

parts.note: to play is to amuse oneself
the right is the conservative wing of politics

explanation.surface: A writer wonders whether to enjoy himself with the Tories.
explanation.definitionFit: A writer of plays is a dramatist.
